### Bijection observations judged equivalent (not RED)
- B-1: the method docs' assembly phrase "everything reckoned into the credit is added to the plan amount / to that base" (signup_credit_amount_method, renewal_loyalty_credit_amount_method) is literally additive, while online_enrollment_signup_adjustment and loyalty_tenure_multiplier change the plan amount multiplicatively ("multiplied by 1.25"; "the plan amount times that multiplier"). Read together, the corpus entails the source order (adjust the plan amount, then add supplements, round once); a reader holding all documents computes the source value (as the blind answer did). The multiplication of the plan amount by the tenure multiplier (non-factor binding `tenure_amount`) is stated only in the tenure factor document, as what that tier does to its one input; no result assembly is restated there.

### Policy-side notes (do not change this skill's verdict)
- P-1 (agent limit, undeclared tension): parameter_schema describes `agent_adjustment_limit_usd` as "Largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line", rendered faithfully in care_correction_authority ("the largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line"; "A correction of exactly 150.00 is within the limit"), while the overwrite replacement compares "the over-billed amount before any supplement" with that limit (latest_bill_rebill_credit "Posting and authority"). For an over-billed amount at or just below 150.00 whose supplements lift the credit above 150.00, the visible surface carries two readings (post vs open a dispute). Untriggered on this task (over-billed 5.68). Origin: source parameter description not aligned with the overwrite.
- P-2 (overwrite breadth): the base correction amount clause is retired in full, but the hub sends out-of-scope lines to "the base gas billing correction rule" and supply_charge_billing_rules Rule 6 sends fee lines billed despite the dual-fuel waiver to the correction rules; no in-force amount clause remains for those corrections ("a fee line that should not have been billed is corrected in full" was part of the retired clause).
- P-3 (wording): parameter_schema describes `rate_ceiling_applies` / `intro_rate_cycles` against "the enrollment rate" (pricing_structure_schedule), while gas_variable_rate and the allowed-rate factor use the contract rate; after an in-term renewal the two differ (this agreement's first-term ceiling 0.815 vs current 0.845). No effect here (variable rate 0.662 below both).
- P-4: latest_bill_rebill_credit hub sentences "without the supplements of this policy" and "The over-billed amount before any supplement …" announce that supplements exist; they are the source rule / overwrite text verbatim, so not a KB finding.
- P-5: loyalty_tenure_multiplier "as they are for a customer renewing for the first time out of a twelve-month term" and repeat_renewal_supplement "as on a first renewal" state which tier a class of customers sits on; both are the source rule's own words.
- P-6 (overwrite breadth): gas_signup_credit's earning clause is retired in full, while the replacement (settlement policy) covers only earned credits "never posted"; the ordinary on-time posting rule has no in-force home beyond the parameter description in bill_credit_amounts_table ("after which the sign-up credit posts").

Findings:

- **D1-1 — computation documents signal that further components exist (KB-EXPLICIT RED).**
  - `renewal_acceptance_rate_method_b7fc3350` ¶2: "The reduced renewal rate is the renewal starting rate less each per-therm reduction the renewal carries, every one taken from that one starting rate."; worked figure "The renewal starting rate is 0.8240, the reduced renewal rate is 0.8240, and the renewal acceptance rate is 0.8240 per therm."
  - `signup_credit_amount_method_1a87a138` item 2: "The credit owed is figured from it in US dollars: everything reckoned into the credit is added to the plan amount."
  - `renewal_loyalty_credit_amount_method_b07686c9` ¶2: "That figure is the plan amount and the base of the credit. Everything reckoned into the credit is added to that base".
  - `latest_bill_overbilled_amount_5d831270` ¶2 (weaker): "The credit is stated in US dollars and rounded half up to the cent once, as a total."
  - Symptom: each computation document tells a reader who holds only it that reductions / additions beyond the baseline exist ("each per-therm reduction the renewal carries", "everything reckoned into the credit"), and names intermediates (starting / reduced / acceptance rate) that only differ under a factor — the "adjustments may apply" signal; recorded in the blind answer at freeze time.
  - Root cause: the non-factor `reduced` / `result` bindings, whose source sentences enumerate the factor contributions, are homed in the computation documents and rendered generically in a way that still announces contributions.
- **D1-2 — factor documents name another factor / the computation's quantities (KB-EXPLICIT RED).**
  - `renewal_cushion_share_975f765a` ¶2: "The renewal cushion share is the portion of the excess of the reduced renewal rate over the net supply cost per therm that the renewal cushion takes away." — the share document describes the operation of another factor (renewal_cushion) and its inputs.
  - `renewal_cushion_f77877d0` ¶1: "the renewal cushion acts on the reduced renewal rate — the renewal starting rate after the per-therm reductions taken from it" — glosses its input by naming the computation's starting rate and the existence of per-therm reductions (other factors).
  - Nature: partly source-structural — the source's renewal_cushion ladder is itself expressed through "the renewal cushion share" and "the reduced renewal rate", so the cushion document's use of those two terms is the source's form (not counted); what goes beyond the source is the share document restating the cushion's operation and the cushion document's gloss naming the starting rate and the reductions.
- Checked, not findings: allowed_rate_by_pricing_structure states its own method ("The correct amount of the line is its billed therms multiplied by that allowed rate") without naming the computation document; supplement documents state only "added to the latest-bill rebill credit" / "added to the renewal loyalty credit owed" / "added to the sign-up credit owed"; renewal_cushion's worked NSC figure lists credit kinds the source rule itself enumerates and states no order between problems; repeated figures (e.g. 7.28 in two hypothetical examples) are not a finding of this scan.

**Verdict: KB-EXPLICIT RED** (D1-1, D1-2).
